source: Rithvik's own Slack integration in /Users/rithvik/universal-voiceos-oauth (integrations/slack/tools-t1.ts, tools-t2.ts, lifecycle.ts, tools.ts). schema_params + confirm are a snapshot transcribed by hand 2026-08-21; snapshot-vs-source fidelity is manual today (see FORMAT.md).

slack_connect.note: Write (opens consent page, stamps cooldown, ends in a vaulted token) but toggle-grade and unconfirmed by design, like the official apps. Re-connecting via the inverse requires the human approval step; session grounding is not restored.

switch.note: Mode flag: 'switch accounts' must actually have been spoken. Declarative today — no runtime lattice check exists for boolean flags in the v3 handlers.

connect_id.note: Only meaningful as the id a prior slack_connect returned (tool_output, rank 3).

lookback_minutes.note: Scope modifier on a read; tier-1 reads are not rank-gated (fail-open, S19.2).

channel.note: Resolved against the live directory; ambiguity returns candidates. Not rank-gated at tier 1.

person.note: Resolved against the live directory. Not rank-gated at tier 1.

inverse.note: chat.delete removes the message for everyone, but recipients may already have read it or been notified — compensation, not reversal. The delete tool itself is unbuilt.

slack_send_message.window_note: Slack imposes no hard deadline on deleting your own message (workspace admin policy can); null = indefinite-but-compensable, never 'safe'.

target.note: Must resolve to exactly one real conversation via the directory (tool_output, rank 3).

text.note: Posted verbatim as dictated; never entity-resolved, consent-surfaced on the card.

query.note: Passed verbatim to search.messages; never entity-resolved.
Lists every plausible match rather than picking one — ambiguity-as-data.

inverse.note: True deterministic inverse exists at the API (same channel/timestamp/name); the tool is unbuilt. A reaction notification may still have fired — accepted residue of the reversible class.

ts.note: Must be grounded in the session registry (groundMessage) — an unproved ts blocks (ungrounded_message).

emoji.note: Validated against the emoji table (invalid_emoji block); cannot carry free text.

message.note: Display arg only — the model's assertion, checked against the grounding registry (assertDisplayArgGrounded), never sent.

inverse.note: The handler already returns scheduled_message_id as the exact undo handle (tools-t2.ts:904). The undo tool itself is unbuilt — RECON confirmed the only reference is that comment.

slack_schedule_message.window_note: Window is dynamic: the inverse is valid until post_at fires; after the send, only the slack_send_message compensation path applies.

when.note: The send instant must come from the user's words; a model-composed time is the ambiguous_time/time_in_past drift family. Enforced today as deterministic resolution + past-rejection (resolveSendInstant), not as rank-4 attribution — that gap is the §22 adoption ask.

post_at.note: Internal alternative; a user-edited `when` re-parses and wins over any model-supplied post_at.

inverse.note: The handler returns reminder_id — the exact handle reminders.delete needs. Tool unbuilt.

time.note: Slack is the parser (phrase handed over verbatim); a response naming no instant blocks (ambiguous_time) rather than guessing. Rank-4 attribution itself is declarative today.

inverse.note: Deletion is compensation: the share notification fired and the file may already have been downloaded.

path.note: Names a local file (known_state, rank 2); existence + size enforced by a statSync hard block (file_not_found / file_empty / file_too_large) before anything is reserved at Slack.

filename.note: Display arg for the card; the tool always executes from path, and path wins on disagreement.

inverse.note: Same compensation shape as slack_send_message: the posted reply's ts comes back and is remembered, but the delete tool is unbuilt.

thread_ts.note: The thread root must be grounded (read or shown this session) before a character posts under it.

broadcast.note: Mode flag that widens the blast radius to the whole channel — must be spoken, never model-inferred. Declarative today.

replying_to.note: Display arg; checked against the grounding registry, never sent.

inverse.note: Full state restore = clear the status and end the snooze. Deterministic, no handle needed. Tool unbuilt.

duration_minutes.note: A duration with no spoken number blocks (missing_duration / invalid_duration) rather than defaulting — the runtime approximation of rank 4.

snooze.note: Mode flag; snooze without a spoken duration blocks. Rank attribution declarative today.

slack_disconnect.note: Toggle-grade and unconfirmed by design (like the official apps' sign-out). Destroys the vaulted token, flushes grounding + directory. The inverse re-opens consent — it needs the human's Allow click, and session grounding does not come back.

slack_health.note: Read-only probe (auth.test); 'connected' may only come from a returned identity, never a stored token.
